d:
Bihar ke betiya (pashchimi chanparan) men dinadhare apradhiyon ne bari lut ki vardat ko anjam dekar pulis prashasan ko khuli chunauti di hai. shahar sthit senko gold (Senco Gold) shorum men hathiyaron ke bal par 8 se 9 apradhiyon ne dhava bola aur karmachariyon ki pitaee karte hue lakhon rupye ke aabhushan samet kar mauke se pharar ho gae. dinadhare huee is bari lut ki ghatna se pure ilake men dahshat phail gaee hai.
Pulis mahakme men macha harkanp, DIG ke netritv men janch shuru
